news.author: servers99

Quick weights-only reality check: • 8B (16-bit): ~16 GB → 24 GB GPU • 14B (16-bit): ~28 GB → tight on RTX 5090 (32 GB); safer on L40S (48 GB) • 32B (16-bit): ~64 GB → A100 80 GB • 70B (4-bit): ~35 GB → 48 GB GPU Bare-metal GPU sizing thread below 👇 # SelfHosted # LLMOps # AI # MachineLearning # Linux
